title: feat(gen): publish a pollinations-sdk agent skill (Fixes #16856)
author: mhmdrizzzki

gist.summary: Added a discoverable Agent Skills guide for writing JavaScript apps and scripts with @pollinations/sdk, distinct from the existing CLI and REST API skills. It covers installing stable SDK 5.0.0, configuring POLLINATIONS_API_KEY, generating text and an image, and saving the image in Node.js. It also points agents to current model IDs, browser authentication guidance, and the installed package’s types for features beyond the quickstart. The skill is listed in the Agent Skills index and llms.txt, with routing tests and deployment workflow triggers updated for it.
